claims.claim: packc compile flags: -c/--config (default config.arena.yaml), -o/--output (default <id>.pack.json), --id (default current folder name sanitized), --pack-version (default v1.0.0)
packc compile and compile-prompt both create the output directory (writePackFile)
packc-action inputs config-file, pack-id, output, validate (default true), packc-version (default latest), working-directory; outputs pack-file, pack-id, prompts, tools; downloads release binary
npm package @altairalabs/packc ships prebuilt binaries for linux/darwin/windows amd64/arm64
packc compile sets name=id, version from --pack-version (default v1.0.0), description 'Pack containing N prompts', $schema latest URL, compilation block
packc validate validates every file argument and exits 1 if any fails
arena config, prompt configs and tool files are schema-validated on load; arena config requires providers and defaults
